node.title: L1 FPC5: large-source full-petal payment
node.statement: Aggregate every first-owned FPC5 contributor on the remaining large source scales after the exact proved prefilter (PF6). The conclusion is one disjoint polynomial/profile allocation across the surviving source layouts, touched-petal sets, defects, and exact owners.
